slides.title: Copy text without the mess
slides.text: Fonts, colors, links, hidden text, invisible characters and tracking junk stay behind. You see exactly what goes.

slides.title: See every change. Undo any copy.
slides.text: Show changes highlights what was removed and why. Restore original puts the page's copy back, formatting included.

slides.title: Alt+Shift+V copies it clean
slides.text: Or right-click → Copy clean. A small note says what was removed, with Undo right there.

slides.title: Or make every Ctrl+C clean
slides.text: Pick the sites where you copy a lot, or all sites. A blue ON badge shows where Ctrl+C is cleaned.

slides.title: Your own cleanup rules
slides.text: Find and replace with text or regular expressions, or start from a preset: "Sent from my iPhone", quoted replies, "Read more at".
